gloss: across the board; all in a row; without exception

definitions.gloss: row of houses; house after house
definitions.explanation: A line of buildings standing side by side along a street.

definitions.gloss: across the board; without exception; one after another
definitions.explanation: Used adverbially to indicate that something applies to every case in a group, without exception. Very common in news and business reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商店|しょうてん}→商店：11841_shouten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軒並|のきな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: The row of shops is neatly lined up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{軒並|のきな}み⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ばされた→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧。
examples.english: The typhoon blew off the roofs of house after house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{軒並|のきな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I strolled along a street where old rows of houses still remain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軒並|のきな}み⟦{下落|げらく}→下落：11321_geraku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Stock prices fell across the board.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軒並|のきな}み⟦{値上|ねあ}げした→値上げする：22504_neagesuru⟧。
examples.english: Restaurants raised prices across the board.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しく→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧、{受験者|じゅけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点数|てんすう}→点数：04543_tensuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軒並|のきな}み⟦{低|ひく}かった→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: This year's entrance exams were difficult, and examinees' scores were low across the board.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{軒|のき}→軒：03912_noki⟧ (eaves, house) + {並|な}み (row, line). Originally described a row of houses, but the adverbial sense 2 is now more common.

As an adverb, {軒並|のきな}み emphasizes that something affects every member of a group uniformly. It is especially frequent in news reporting about market trends, price changes, and widespread phenomena.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軒並|のきな}み⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧ (rise across the board)
- {軒並|のきな}み⟦{下落|げらく}→下落：11321_geraku⟧ (fall across the board)
- {軒並|のきな}み⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧ (price hikes across the board)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一様|いちよう}→一様：11232_ichiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: uniformly (more formal)
- ⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: all at once (emphasizes simultaneity)
- ⟦どれも→どれも：22934_doremo⟧: all of them (colloquial, less emphatic)
